summary.text: Tim O'Brien is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 78 who was appointed to the seat in March 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Sally Busby as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Tim O'Brien earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Southern Indiana in 2015.

He worked as a real estate broker with F.C. Tucker Emge Realtors and has served on the boards of the Evansville Land Bank Corporation, the Indiana Association of Realtors and Heritage Federal Credit Union.
O'Brien was appointed to the seat in 2021 after Holli Sullivan was appointed Indiana Secretary of State, and he took office on March 30, 2021.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Government and Regulatory Reform, Veterans Affairs and Public Safety, and Ways and Means committees.
